mapper.select: SELECT * FROM groupbuy_groups WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE groupbuy_groups SET status = 'OPEN', version = version + 1, updated_by = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'INIT'
UPDATE groupbuy_groups SET reserved_count = reserved_count + 1, version = version + 1, updated_by = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND reserved_count < target_count
UPDATE groupbuy_groups SET reserved_count = GREATEST(reserved_count - 1, 0), version = version + 1, updated_by = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE groupbuy_groups SET paid_count = paid_count + 1, version = version + 1, updated_by = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND paid_count < target_count
UPDATE groupbuy_groups SET paid_count = GREATEST(paid_count - 1, 0), reserved_count = GREATEST(reserved_count - 1, 0), version = version + 1, updated_by = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE groupbuy_groups SET status = 'SUCCESS', version = version + 1, updated_by = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND paid_count >= target_count
UPDATE groupbuy_groups SET status = 'FAILED', version = version + 1, updated_by = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND expire_at <= NOW()
